title: Milestone payment handled entirely by existing contract and payment rails
operational_setting: A supplier is paid after an independently verified delivery milestone using an ordinary contract and existing payment infrastructure.
trust_boundary: Independent parties coordinate result acceptance and payment.
intended_transition: Milestone accepted and payment obligation fulfilled.

attack.procedure: Use ART/TSTO only for target/verification semantics while leaving settlement entirely to existing contract and payment infrastructure.

success_criteria_for_attack: If no ART-specific settlement abstraction is needed, Settlement should remain an external integration point rather than a core ART layer.

verdict.rationale: Tests complementarity with existing financial infrastructure.
